Name: NoFlowerHarvest
Author: Saodm262
Description:
[size=4][b]# No Flower Harvest (禁止采花 / 花の収穫禁止)

## Description

Tired of accidentally picking the flowers you carefully planted — a stray right-click, one scythe swing, or a junimo that grabs everything in sight? **No Flower Harvest** stops you from harvesting the flowers you planted yourself, so they stay in the ground to keep decorating your farm and feeding your bee houses all season long.

The mod blocks the harvesting of every plantable flower crop: Blue Jazz, Tulip, Poppy, Summer Spangle, Fairy Rose and Sunflower in the vanilla game, plus **any new flower crops added by expansion mods** such as Stardew Valley Expanded and Ridgeside Village — automatically, with no manual configuration. The flower crop is never destroyed; it simply stays planted.

It can also optionally block **outdoor flower forage** — Daffodil, Dandelion, Sweet Pea and Crocus, plus flower forage from expansion mods (e.g. SVE's Thistle or Goldenrod). Forage blocking is **off by default** and can be enabled per item or all at once.

## Installation instructions

1. Install **SMAPI** (Stardew Modding API) for Stardew Valley 1.6 — see the [SMAPI install guide](https://smapi.io/).
2. *(Optional but recommended)* Install **Generic Mod Config Menu** ([Nexus Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098)) so you can manage each flower's permission from an in-game menu.
3. Download this mod and unzip it. You should end up with a `NoFlowerHarvest` folder that contains `manifest.json`, `NoFlowerHarvest.dll` and an `i18n` folder.
4. Move that `NoFlowerHarvest` folder into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder.
5. Launch the game through SMAPI (run `StardewModdingAPI.exe`, or launch via Steam if you installed SMAPI that way).
6. Done! Planted flowers can no longer be harvested. Open the config menu (**Esc → gear icon → Generic Mod Config Menu → No Flower Harvest**) to allow individual flowers.

## Main features

- **Blocks every harvest method** — right-click harvest, scythe harvest, junimo harvesters and modded tools (e.g. Tractor Mod) are all intercepted. The flower crop is never destroyed; it simply stays planted.
- **Expansion-mod friendly** — flowers are detected using the same logic the game itself uses for bee-house honey (the harvest item's "Flower" category), so any mod that adds plantable flower crops — Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village and others — is picked up automatically. No hardcoded lists to maintain.
- **Per-flower control** — the config menu lists every discovered flower with its own toggle. **By default every flower is blocked**; tick the ones you want to allow.
- **Optional forage-flower blocking** — outdoor flower forage can be blocked per item or all at once via a master toggle (allowed by default, matching vanilla behaviour).
- **Smart defaults** — newly discovered flowers are added to the list automatically and blocked by default, so new content can never sneak past the rule.
- **Clear feedback** — when a harvest is blocked, a red message tells you why (throttled so it never spams the screen).
- **Full control** — master switch, "allow everything" override, a separate junimo toggle, and the `noflower_list` / `noflower_refresh` console commands.
- **Fully localized** — all menus, messages and even the mod's name and hover description follow your game language: English, 中文, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português, Русский, Italiano (other languages fall back to English). Flower names use the game's own localized names.

## Requirements

- **Stardew Valley 1.6+** (built and tested on 1.6.15).
- **SMAPI 4.0.0+** — required.
- **Generic Mod Config Menu** — optional but strongly recommended for the per-flower toggles.
- **Multiplayer** — install the mod on the host (and ideally on every farmhand's machine) so all players get the same behaviour.

## Shout outs

- **ConcernedApe** for creating Stardew Valley and open-sourcing the game code that this mod's compatibility approach is based on.
- **Pathoschild** and the SMAPI team for the modding API, built-in Harmony integration and the excellent build package.
- **spacechase0** (and kittycatcasey) for Generic Mod Config Menu.
- **FlashShifter** and the Stardew Valley Expanded team for the most impressive expansion content pack out there — the goal of "just works with big content packs" was inspired by them.
- The **Stardew Valley Wiki** contributors for their endlessly helpful documentation.[/b][/size]
